 Game Discussion Thread: Knicks at 76ers, October 30, 2026
 The Knicks face the Sixers for the second time this season, this time in a Cup game.
 by Russell Richardson Oct 30, 2026, 10:30 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Sixers have gone 4-1 so far this season, and LeBron James has impressed in their locker room Bridge and Canasta games. Philly sits tied for first in the east behind Tyrese Maxey, with his 28 points per game, and Joel Embiid, who has stayed healthy for four of their five contests. Nick Nurse has his assortment of stars ranked top-five for defense. In late-breaking news, Jaylen Brown will miss the game due to left patellar tendiopathy, which my medical dictionary defines as “Fear of Knickerbocker.”
 Tonight, they welcome the World Champion Knicks (2-3) in an Emirates Cup game. New York lost their opener to the Sixers, so let’s settle the score, eh? Game time is at 7 p.m. EST on Prime Video. This is your game thread. This is Liberty Ballers . Please don’t post large photos, GIFs, or links to illegal streams in the thread. Be excellent humans. And go Knicks!
